label: رسمي

angle.hook: SEGA says 2,196,044 newsletter email addresses leaked from its delivery vendor Arara, and nothing else such as names or card details
angle.why_now: SEGA published its notice on 9 Nov 2026; Arara confirmed the leak to SEGA on 3 Nov
angle.what_it_means_here: Only email addresses are affected per SEGA, so the risk is phishing; SEGA advises caution with emails impersonating it
angle.payoff: what SEGA says did not leak, and its advice

sensitive: none; breach rule: SEGA's own notice only, no methods, no third-party claims, no leaked material, our bed

decision_log.shot: four logofact cards (SEGA logo plate, large figure, label, two lines) on the site key art ground, then the key art unblurred panning as the closing picture
decision_log.alternatives: no official footage of the story exists; leaked material never shown

decision_log.music: our channel bed (legal/leak rule, CLAUDE.md 26 Oct point 3); no footage sound exists

note: Numbers on SEGA's own site art (700x470 key image from sega.co.jp, blurred and dimmed as ground only). Unrelated game art used only as a ground; credit names SEGA. v2 (director fixes): SEGA logo (official site logo-sega.svg rendered to PNG, templates/assets/brands/sega-logo.png) on a white plate, larger figures, cards fill the safe zone, last shot the key art unblurred.
